entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We got letters from four of the VIPs.
entries.uk: У нас листи від чотирьох VIP-гостей.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All that's left is the last one. Some guy[n]they call the cleaner.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He's gotta be around here somewhere![n]Let's find him!
entries.uk: Він має бути десь тут! Знайдімо його!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It seems he's even more cautious than[n]rumored...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We've come this far! We're not gonna[n]back down now!
entries.uk: Ми стільки пройшли! Тепер ми не[n]відступимо!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I wonder why he's so afraid.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Prolly because people are always trying[n]to kill him.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right then! Let's keep cornering him!
